newton.label: Newton ke laws of motion
newton.kid: Gend ko dhakka do toh chalti hai, rok do toh rukti hai. Jitna zor, utni tez. Aur deewar ko dhakka do toh deewar bhi tumhe utna hi wapas dhakelti hai.
exam: First law: koi cheez apni state (rest ya motion) tab tak nahi badalti jab tak net force na lage (inertia).
Second law: F = m x a. Force, mass aur acceleration ka product hai.
Third law: har action ka barabar aur opposite reaction hota hai.
newton.real: Bus achanak ruke toh hum aage jhukte hain (inertia). Rocket gas peeche phenkta hai, khud aage jaata hai (third law).

check.q: 2 kg ki trolley ko 3 m/s2 acceleration dena hai. Kitna force?
check.a: F = m x a = 2 x 3 = 6 N

topics: Second law: F = m x a

current.label: Electric current
current.kid: Wire mein chhote chhote charges line mein chalte hain, jaise pipe mein paani. Jitna zyada charge ek second mein nikle, utna zyada current.
exam: Electric current = charge per unit time: I = Q / t.
SI unit ampere (A): 1 A = 1 coulomb per second.
Conventional current positive se negative terminal ki taraf maana jaata hai.
current.real: Phone charger pe likha 2 A matlab har second 2 coulomb charge phone ki taraf jaata hai.

check.q: 5 second mein 10 C charge guzra. Current kitna?

refraction.label: Refraction of light
refraction.kid: Roshni ek cheez se doosri mein jaate hi apni speed badalti hai, isliye thoda mud jaati hai. Isi liye paani mein pencil tedhi dikhti hai.
exam: Refraction: light ka ek medium se doosre medium mein jaate waqt mudna.
Refractive index n = c / v (vacuum mein speed / medium mein speed).
Snell ka law: n1 sin i = n2 sin r.
refraction.real: Chashme aur camera lens refraction se image focus karte hain.

check.q: Glass mein light ki speed 2 x 10^8 m/s hai. Refractive index? (c = 3 x 10^8 m/s)

bonding.label: Chemical bonding
bonding.kid: Atoms akele adhoore lagte hain, isliye electrons share ya exchange karke dost ban jaate hain aur stable ho jaate hain.
exam: Ionic bond: ek atom electron deta hai, doosra leta hai (jaise NaCl).
Covalent bond: atoms electrons share karte hain (jaise H2O).
Atoms octet (8 outer electrons) pura karke stable bante hain.
bonding.real: Namak (NaCl) ionic hai, isliye paani mein ghul jaata hai. Paani ke molecule covalent bonds se bante hain.

check.q: Na ke paas 1 outer electron hai, Cl ke paas 7. Electron transfer ke baad Cl ke paas kitne?

mole.label: Mole concept
mole.kid: Darzan matlab 12, waise hi chemistry mein ek mole matlab bahut saare particles, ek fixed ginti. Isse atoms ginna aasaan hota hai.
exam: 1 mole = 6.022 x 10^23 particles (Avogadro number).
Moles = given mass / molar mass.
Molar mass grams per mole mein hota hai.
mole.real: Dawai banane wale aur cooking gas ke cylinder bharne wale bhi mass se moles ka hisaab lagate hain.

check.q: 36 g paani mein kitne moles? (molar mass 18 g/mol)

integration.label: Integration (area under curve)
integration.kid: Ek tedhi line ke neeche ki jagah naapni ho toh usse bahut patli patli strips mein kaato aur sab jodo. Wahi integration hai.
exam: Integration differentiation ka ulta hai (antiderivative).
Integral of x^n dx = x^(n+1) / (n+1) + C, jab n alag ho -1 se.
Definite integral a se b tak curve ke neeche ka area deta hai.
integration.real: Speed ka graph ho toh uske neeche ka area kitni doori tay hui, woh batata hai.

check.q: y = 2x ka area x = 0 se x = 3 tak?
check.a: Integral of 2x = x^2, toh 3^2 minus 0 = 9 square units

probability.label: Probability
probability.kid: Kisi cheez ke hone ka chance. Sikka uchhalo toh head aane ka chance aadha.
exam: P(event) = favourable outcomes / total outcomes.
Probability hamesha 0 aur 1 ke beech hoti hai.
P(not A) = 1 minus P(A).
probability.real: Weather app ka 70% baarish ka chance bhi probability hai.

check.q: Do dice phenko, sum 7 aane ka chance?

photosynthesis.label: Photosynthesis
photosynthesis.kid: Paude dhoop, paani aur hawa ki carbon dioxide se apna khana banate hain, aur badle mein humein oxygen dete hain.
exam: 6CO2 + 6H2O + light energy se C6H12O6 + 6O2 banta hai.
Ye chloroplast mein hota hai, chlorophyll light absorb karta hai.
Light reactions aur dark reactions (Calvin cycle) do stages hain.
photosynthesis.real: Hum jo oxygen lete hain aur jo anaaj khaate hain, dono ki shuruaat photosynthesis se hoti hai.

check.q: Equation mein left side pe carbon atoms kitne? (6CO2)
check.a: 6 x 1 = 6, aur glucose C6H12O6 mein bhi 6

supply.label: Demand aur supply
supply.kid: Jab koi cheez sab ko chahiye aur kam ho, toh uska daam badhta hai. Jab bahut saari ho aur kam log chahein, toh daam girta hai.
exam: Law of demand: price badhe toh demand ghatti hai (baaki sab same).
Law of supply: price badhe toh supply badhti hai.
Equilibrium: jahan demand = supply.
supply.real: Barish mein chhatri ka daam aur Diwali pe mithai ka daam demand aur supply se badalta hai.

check.q: Demand Qd = 100 minus 2P, supply Qs = 20 + 2P. Equilibrium price?

recursion.label: Recursion (coding)
recursion.kid: Russian dolls kholte jao, har doll ke andar chhoti doll. Sabse chhoti pe ruk jao. Function bhi khud ko chhote kaam ke saath bulata hai.
exam: Recursive function khud ko call karta hai.
Base case pe recursion rukta hai, warna woh chalta hi rahega.
Example: factorial(n) = n x factorial(n minus 1), factorial(1) = 1.
recursion.real: Folders ke andar folders ki saari files dhoondhna recursion se aasaan hota hai.

ai_class.label: AI tools classroom mein hone chahiye
for: AI har student ko apni speed se seekhne deta hai.
Teachers ka time bachta hai, woh students pe focus kar sakte hain.
Future ke kaam mein AI ka sahi use aana zaroori hai.
against: Bina soche AI pe depend hona seekhne ko kamzor kar sakta hai.
Har student ke paas same device aur internet nahi hai.
AI ke answer kabhi kabhi galat hote hain, check karna padta hai.
ai_class.openFor: Calculator ne maths khatam nahi kiya, use behtar banaya. AI bhi waisa hi tool hai.
ai_class.openAgainst: Tool tab achha hai jab haath khud bhi kaam karna jaanta ho.
rebutFor: Depend hone ka hal hai sahi use sikhana, ban karna nahi.
Galat answers pakadna bhi ek skill hai jo classroom mein seekhi ja sakti hai.
rebutAgainst: Speed se seekhna achha hai, par basics ke bina speed kis kaam ki?
Teacher ka time bachana achha hai, par student ka sochna bhi bachana hai.

homework.label: Homework optional hona chahiye
for: Har student ki seekhne ki speed alag hoti hai.
Free time mein hobbies aur skills bhi badhti hain.
Zabardasti ka kaam aksar copy hota hai.
against: Practice ke bina concept pakka nahi hota.
Homework discipline aur time management sikhata hai.
Teacher ko pata chalta hai kaun sa topic samajh nahi aaya.
homework.openFor: Seekhna zabardasti se nahi, interest se hota hai.
homework.openAgainst: Practice ke bina koi khiladi match nahi jeet-ta, padhai bhi waisi hi hai.
rebutFor: Practice zaroori hai, par har din ek jaisa homework zaroori nahi.
Discipline apne goals se bhi aata hai.
rebutAgainst: Hobbies achhi hain, par basics ki practice bhi utni hi zaroori.
Copy ki problem ka hal achha homework design hai, homework hatana nahi.

uniform.label: Uniform hona zaroori hai
for: Uniform se sab barabar mehsoos karte hain.
Subah kya pehnein, yeh tension khatam.
Pehchaan aur team spirit badhta hai.
against: Kapdon se bhi apni personality dikhti hai.
Uniform har mausam mein comfortable nahi hota.
Har family ke liye extra kharcha ho sakta hai.
uniform.openFor: Jab sab ek jaise dikhte hain, tab sab ki baat suni jaati hai.
uniform.openAgainst: Har student alag hai, toh dikhne mein bhi thoda alag hone do.
rebutFor: Personality kapdon se zyada ideas aur kaam se dikhti hai.
Mausam ke hisaab se uniform options diye ja sakte hain.
rebutAgainst: Barabari ka ehsaas kapdon se nahi, behaviour se aata hai.
Tension khatam karne ke aur bhi simple tareeke hain.

projects.label: Exams se zyada projects se assessment ho
for: Team mein kaam karna seekhte hain.
Ek din ke exam ka pressure kam hota hai.
against: Exams sab ke liye ek jaisa fair test hai.
Projects mein kabhi kabhi kaam ek hi insaan karta hai.
Exam basics ki pakki jaanch karta hai.
projects.openFor: Duniya mein koi ek ghante ka paper nahi deta, sab projects karte hain.
projects.openAgainst: Fair game ke liye sab ke liye ek jaisa rule chahiye.
rebutFor: Fairness project ke clear rubric se bhi aa sakti hai.
Team mein har member ka role likha ja sakta hai.
rebutAgainst: Skills dikhana achha hai, par basics ke bina project kamzor hota hai.
Pressure kam karne ke liye exam ka pattern badla ja sakta hai.

sports.label: Sports period roz hona chahiye

sports.openAgainst: Har din sab ke liye ek jaisa plan sahi nahi hota.
rebutFor: Time table mein chhote periods se jagah ban sakti hai.
Sports mein bhi bahut options ho sakte hain, sirf ek game nahi.
rebutAgainst: Fresh dimaag achha hai, par roz zaroori nahi, hafte mein 3 din bhi kaafi.
Team work clubs aur projects se bhi aata hai.

screen.label: Social media se fayda zyada hai, nuksaan kam
